title: Deadlock

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Deadlock. Steam lists the title as coming soon with no structured release date; dating is flagged for review as the playtest / early access status changes.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Valve multiplayer services.
preservation.concerns: Unreleased / coming-soon multiplayer holdings face elevated revision and access risk as builds change in place. Account-bound licensing and the absence of a retained offline installer remain principal concerns.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam store lists Deadlock as coming soon with release date “To be announced.” This accession records the account-bound digital holding currently in archive custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required services remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
